scope: Stage 7 (visualization), first part: magnon band figure and spin-configuration figure on the common model types. Design approved by the user on 2026-10-01 (proposal: figures draw only what an observable computed).
api: spintoolkit.visualization.plot_bands(bands, ax=None, *, energy_scale=1.0, energy_label='E / E0', mark_zero_modes=True, color='C0', linewidth=1.4) -> Axes; spintoolkit.visualization.plot_spin_configuration(model, state, n_repeat=1, ...) -> (fig, axes); a SpinSystem as first argument still works with a DeprecationWarning (D30).
rules: Lines are the stored BandStructure energies times the display scale; nothing is recomputed.
Energies stay in E0 (D20); a display unit needs an explicit energy_scale with a matching energy_label (a scale other than one with the default label raises).
Unstable momenta (NaN) stay gaps and are shaded; never interpolated.
Zero modes are marked at E = 0; Goldstone or accidental is not decided by the figure.
Magnetic-cell bands are drawn folded, as band_structure returns them.

added.code-space/spintoolkit/visualization/spi: (SpinModel, SpinState) input through to_spin_system; drawing unchanged

findings: Square Neel (2 bands of the 2-site magnetic cell) and triangular 120 degrees (3 folded bands): every plotted line equals BandStructure.energies exactly; zero-mode markers at the 3 marked momenta (Goldstone vertices) at E = 0.

Square antiferromagnet polarized below saturation (h = 3 < h_sat = 2zJS = 4): the dispersion h - 2(1 - gamma_k) is negative around M; band_structure gives NaN exactly where the formula is negative (85 of 301 points), the figure leaves that interval as a shaded gap, and the stable part matches the formula within 1.3e-15.

Spin-configuration direction panel (decided 2026-10-01 under the user's delegation): the earlier panel drew only the polar angle theta, so a coplanar state (all theta = 90 degrees, e.g. 120 degrees) collapsed to one direction. It now shows each spin seen from +z: an arrow at the azimuth phi (same convention as the in-plane arrows of the lattice panel) with length sin(theta), coloured by Sz; spins along +-z are dots at the centre. The 120 degree state shows three unit arrows 120 degrees apart (test).

warnings: H(k) is not positive semidefinite at 85 path points (unstable reference state);
